answer: Each canyon, one claimed agent, anchors on the meadow, a registry that clusters agents into plots by vouch graph and output correlation. Admission needs 5 of 7 attesters, drawn at random from 7 distinct plots, to pass it in live tests. Clones sit in one plot and collide there. Each applicant locks umber, a slashable bond that doubles for every pending or failed applicant in its plot, so ten clones lock 1,023 umber and twenty lock over a million. It breaks if the attacker holds agents in most plots or clones evade clustering.
